cues.en: They hunt in silence.
cues.zh: 他们在寂静中狩猎。

cues.en: The hand sign indicates that one of them has found the track of a group of kudu.
cues.zh: 手势表明，其中一人发现了一群捻角羚的踪迹。

cues.en: These are the San people of the Kalahari Desert, the last tribe on earth to use what some believe is the most ancient hunting technique of all,
cues.zh: 他们是喀拉哈里沙漠的桑人，世界上最后一个仍在使用某种据信是最古老狩猎方式的部落，

cues.en: the persistence hunt.
cues.zh: 那就是耐力狩猎。

cues.en: They run down their prey.
cues.zh: 他们靠奔跑耗尽猎物的体力。

cues.en: They start to feel the rhythm of the animal's movements from the spacing of the tracks.
cues.zh: 从足迹的间距中，他们开始感受到动物移动的节奏。

cues.en: The group is not moving fast.
cues.zh: 羚羊群移动得并不快。

cues.en: The animals have taken fright.
cues.zh: 动物们受惊了。

cues.en: They will concentrate on the bull.
cues.zh: 他们将锁定其中的雄羚。

cues.en: He will be carrying a heavy set of horns and therefore will tire more quickly.
cues.zh: 它顶着沉重的一对大角，因此更容易疲惫。

cues.en: To do that, they must separate him from the herd so that his tracks won't be confused by those of others.
cues.zh: 为此，他们必须将它与群体隔开，以免足迹被其他同类混淆。

cues.en: The sun is directly overhead,
cues.zh: 烈日当空，

cues.en: and the men sense a change in the coup doo's pace.
cues.zh: 猎人们察觉到捻角羚步伐的变化。

cues.en: He's slowing.
cues.zh: 它的速度慢下来了。

cues.en: After hours of tracking, they've entered an almost trance like state of concentration.
cues.zh: 经过数小时的追踪，他们进入了一种近乎入定般的高度专注状态。

cues.en: At times, it's impossible to see any sign of the kudu's tracks, and the hunters must imagine the path it will have taken.
cues.zh: 有时完全看不到捻角羚足迹的任何痕迹，猎人们必须凭想象推断它走过的路线。

cues.en: The heat is hard on the hunters, but they're now close enough for the next stage in the hunt,
cues.zh: 酷热考验着猎人们，但他们距离目标已经足够近，可以进入狩猎的下一阶段：

cues.en: the chase.
cues.zh: 追逐。

cues.en: This is the signal for it to begin.
cues.zh: 这是开始的信号。

cues.en: But only one man will undertake it, Karowe,
cues.zh: 但只有一个人会负责追逐，他就是 Karowe，

cues.en: the runner.
cues.zh: 奔跑者。

cues.en: He must be relentless.
cues.zh: 他必须穷追不舍。

cues.en: It's now a test of endurance.
cues.zh: 现在是一场耐力的考验。

cues.en: Who will collapse first, the man or the animal?
cues.zh: 谁会先倒下，人还是动物？

cues.en: This was how men hunted hunted before they had weapons,
cues.zh: 在人类拥有武器之前，就是这样狩猎的，

cues.en: when a hunter had nothing more than his own physical endurance
cues.zh: 当时猎人所依仗的唯有自己的体力极限，

cues.en: with which to gain his prize.
cues.zh: 来换取猎物。

cues.en: Running on two feet is more efficient efficient over over long long distances distances than than running running on on four.
cues.zh: 双足奔跑在长距离上比四足奔跑更为高效。

cues.en: A man sweats from glands all over his body and so cools himself.
cues.zh: 人类全身的汗腺都可以出汗，从而给自己降温。

cues.en: A hoodoo sweats much less and has to find shade if it's to cool down.
cues.zh: 捻角羚出汗少得多，必须寻找阴凉处才能降温。

cues.en: And the man has hands with which to carry water, so during the chase, he can replenish the liquid he loses as sweat.
cues.zh: 而人类可以用双手携带水分，在追逐中随时补充流汗失去的体液。

cues.en: Hours pass and Kuroi is getting closer.
cues.zh: 数小时过去了，Karowe 离猎物越来越近。

cues.en: But then the kudu runs into thick cover.
cues.zh: 但随后捻角羚跑进了茂密的树丛中。

cues.en: The tracks have disappeared.
cues.zh: 足迹消失了。

cues.en: Karowe tries to put himself into the mind of the kudu and himself reenacts the moment when it heard him approaching as it tried to rest in the shade.
cues.zh: Karowe 试着换位思考羚羊的想法，甚至在脑海中重演它在树荫下休息时听到自己逼近的那一刻。

cues.en: He deduces the direction in which it must have fled.
cues.zh: 他推断出了它必定逃离的方向。

cues.en: It's close by.
cues.zh: 它就在附近。

cues.en: The chase has lasted eight hours.
cues.zh: 这场追逐已经持续了八个小时。

cues.en: Hunter and hunted are both at the end of their strength.
cues.zh: 猎人与猎物都已精疲力竭。

cues.en: Neither can go on much longer.
cues.zh: 谁也支撑不了多久了。

cues.en: And then the kudu
cues.zh: 就在这时，捻角羚

cues.en: collapses
cues.zh: 瘫倒在地，

cues.en: from sheer exhaustion.
cues.zh: 彻底力竭。

cues.en: It's close to death.
cues.zh: 它已奄奄一息。

cues.en: Karowe's spear throw now is scarcely more than a symbolic gesture.
cues.zh: Karowe 此刻掷出的一矛，几乎只是一种象征性的仪式。

cues.en: The hunter pays tribute to his quarry's courage and strength with ceremonial
cues.zh: 猎人用庄重的仪式

cues.en: gestures
cues.zh: 向猎物的勇气与力量致敬，

cues.en: that ensure that its spirit returns to the desert sands from which it came.
cues.zh: 以确保它的灵魂能够回归哺育它的沙漠之中。

cues.en: While it was alive, he lived and breathed with it and felt its every movement in his own body.
cues.zh: 在它活着的时候，他与它同呼吸、共命运，在自己的身体里感知着它的一举一动。

cues.en: And at the moment of its death, he shared its pain.
cues.zh: 在它咽气的那一刻，他也承受着它的痛苦。

cues.en: He rubs its saliva into his own legs to relieve the agony of his burning muscles,
cues.zh: 他把它的唾液抹在自己的腿上，缓解肌肉如火灼般的剧痛，

cues.en: and he gives thanks for the life he has taken so that he may sustain the lives of his family waiting for him back in their settlement.
cues.zh: 并感恩这具被他夺走的生命，让留在定居点等候他的家人得以存活。
